question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT channel, SUM(amount_spent) AS total_spent
FROM marketing_spend
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure
sql:
SELECT ms.channel
FROM marketing_spend ms
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ms.month) IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY ms.channel
ORDER BY SUM(ms.amount_spent) DESC
LIMIT 1;
